rules.statement: A lease in breach of Section 67 of the Partition Act is void.
rules.supporting_quote: 1) The defendant-appellant had been appointed as tenant cultivator of the paddy field ' pendente lite ' in breach of S. 67 of the Partition Act. That lease was void. 2) The defendant-appellant is not entitled to the protection under S. 3 (2) of the Agricultural Lands Law
